The first release of **Forus**, a fast, GPU-rendered photo and video viewer for Windows 11.

## Download

- **`Forus-0.1.0-setup.exe`**: the installer (recommended). It installs for your account only, so there's no administrator prompt. It adds Forus to the Start menu and *Apps & features*, registers it for every supported file type, and can make it your default photo and video viewer.
- **`forus.exe`**: the app on its own, if you'd rather not install anything. Run it from anywhere.

Windows SmartScreen may warn that the app is from an unknown publisher, because these builds aren't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

## Highlights

- **GPU rendering** with Direct3D 11 and Direct2D: instant zoom, pan and rotate at any image size.
- **Hardware video playback** through Media Foundation, with frames going straight to the GPU.
- **Custom Windows 11 title bar** with quick tools, and Snap Layouts on the maximize button.
- **Lots of formats:**
  - Windows' own codecs: JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WebP, JPEG XR and more.
  - Built in: SVG, Photoshop PSD/PSB, JPEG XL, OpenEXR, HDR, TGA, QOI, PCX, PNM, ICNS, and Krita, OpenRaster, Procreate and Sketch documents.
  - Animated GIF, WebP and PNG playback.
  - Camera RAW. Files open even without Microsoft's Raw Image Extension, by showing the full-size preview the camera embeds.
  - HEIC/AVIF and HEVC/AV1 via their Microsoft Store extensions.
- **Default app support:** pick Forus in Settings → Default apps with one click (press **D** in the app).

Press **F1** in the app for all keyboard shortcuts.
